item.title: How chainflip Moves Native Assets Across Chains
item.description: chainflip routes a wallet deposit through validator witnessing and State Chain liquidity, then pays the native output to your chosen address on another chain.

item.title: Base Cobalt adds conditional transactions and B20 controls
item.description: Base activated Cobalt on mainnet, adding validity transactions and B20 controls that gate inclusion by chain state and give issuers new policy tools.
